memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Stable glaucoma, psoriasis, and epilepsy.
She reports no eye pain, redness, or visual blur; skin plaques are limited to elbows and knees with mild scaling; she has had no seizures in the past month and takes her medications regularly. On examination, visual acuity is 6/9 bilaterally, intraocular pressure measured 22 mm Hg OU, skin shows mild erythematous plaques, neurological exam is non‑focal. Smoking status: never. She denies any new medications or intercurrent illness.
